overview: The City Council and Community Development Board held a joint meeting to advance zoning reforms for Medford Square, including a specific overlay for the redevelopment of parking lots behind City Hall. Both bodies closed public hearings on several items and established a revised legislative calendar through June 2026.

items.title: Public Hearing: Medford Square Zoning (Paper 26023)
items.summary: The City Council voted to close its public hearing on the proposed Medford Square zoning amendments following public testimony regarding tree canopy protections and design standards. The Community Development Board voted to continue its portion of the public hearing to April 15.

items.title: Public Hearing: Medford Square City Hall Overlay District (Paper 26058)
items.summary: The Community Development Board recommended approval of a zoning overlay for three city-owned lots to facilitate a proposed 300-unit mixed-use development by Transom Real Estate. Both bodies voted to close the public hearing after amending the proposal to align its allowed uses with the broader Medford Square district and ensuring a freestanding parking garage is allowed by right.

items.title: Updated Zoning Meeting Schedule (Paper 26052)
items.summary: Approved a revised schedule for joint and committee meetings through June 2026 to ensure the completion of Boston Avenue and Tufts University zoning reviews before consultant contracts expire.
